versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the hotel aggregation assistant.
- Integrates major hotel data sources (Fenbeitong, Ctrip, Meituan, Tongcheng, Huazhu, Jinjiang) for unified hotel search, price comparison, and booking.
- Supports multi-platform hotel data aggregation, intelligent de-duplication, standardized search format, and optimal price selection.
- Provides user-friendly commands and response formats with clear data source attribution and strict data accuracy constraints.
